description: Centralized, promise-based dialog manager for React with slot-based updates and adapters for MUI, Base UI, shadcn, and Tailwind.
rules: Import adapters from subpaths: dialogist/mui, dialogist/base-ui, dialogist/shadcn, dialogist/tailwind.
Import dialogist/styles.css and set DialogProvider cssMode to "external" when you control CSS.
Use sentence case for user-facing dialog titles and button labels.
